_: Handskrivna bildpromptar per recept (Session 158, 2026-10-21) — skrivna efter att ha läst varje recepts ingredienser och steg, så bilden visar rätten som den faktiskt blir (t.ex. smulig stekt fläskfärs i ramen, inte fläskbiffar). generate-local.mjs lägger på den gemensamma fotostilen. Nyckel = recept-id; titeln är bara för läsbarhet.
style: Overhead food photograph, shot straight from above with a 50mm lens, soft natural window daylight, on a light linen tablecloth, simple matte ceramic tableware, Swedish everyday home cooking, realistic and appetizing, slightly rustic, no hands, no people, no text, no logos.

1.title: Gräddig fiskgratäng med purjo
1.prompt: A white oven dish with a creamy baked fish gratin: pieces of white cod in a pale cream sauce topped with soft sautéed sliced leek, lightly golden on top, served with a bowl of cooked whole wheat grain (matvete) and bright green peas on the side.

6.title: Pastasallad med kyckling, feta och basilika
6.prompt: A large bowl of pasta salad with penne, chunks of roast chicken, cubes of white feta cheese, halved cherry tomatoes, black olives, finely chopped red onion, diced red bell pepper and torn fresh basil leaves, lightly dressed with olive oil, served at room temperature.

13.title: Nudlar i röd curry
13.prompt: A deep bowl of thick udon noodles in a creamy red Thai coconut curry broth with golden cubes of fried tofu, sliced spring onion greens on top, a lime wedge on the rim, a sprinkle of crispy fried onion and sesame seeds.

16.title: Bönstroganoff
16.prompt: A plate of vegetarian bean stroganoff: mixed beans in a creamy pale orange paprika and tomato cream sauce with thyme, served over a mound of fluffy white rice, a little chopped parsley on top.

20.title: Citronrisoni med rostad spetskål
20.prompt: A plate of creamy lemon risoni (tiny rice-shaped pasta in a glossy cream sauce with lemon zest) with a wedge of oven-roasted pointed cabbage with charred golden edges on top, finished with finely grated grana padano and a little parsley.

22.title: Parmesanpotatis med kallrökt lax
22.prompt: A baking tray lined with parchment holding smashed boiled potatoes crisped under the grill with a golden crust of grated parmesan and flaky salt, served with folded slices of cold-smoked salmon, a bowl of lemon crème fraîche and a few green lettuce leaves.

23.title: Minestrone
23.prompt: A deep plate of rustic Italian minestrone: a reddish tomato broth with small shell pasta, diced carrot, finely sliced leek and celery, crispy pancetta cubes, topped with a raw egg yolk in the centre, a generous snowfall of grated parmesan and a few basil leaves.

24.title: Tonfiskpasta
24.prompt: Italian pasta al tonno made with canned tuna: a plate of fettuccine coated in a chunky tomato sauce that is speckled all through with small shredded flakes of pale tuna, the same soft flaky crumbled texture as tuna straight from the tin, evenly mixed into the sauce with chopped tomatoes, sliced celery, green capers, onion and chili flakes in olive oil. An opened tin of flaked tuna in water stands next to the plate. No cream, no cheese.

29.title: Stekt curryris med färs och salladslök
29.prompt: A plate of yellow curry fried rice with browned minced beef, shredded white cabbage, coarsely grated carrot and green peas, topped with sliced spring onion and chopped nuts, a small dish of sriracha on the side.

30.title: Valnötshummus med ugnsrostade grönsaker
30.prompt: A sheet pan of oven-roasted vegetables with golden edges: potato wedges, cabbage wedges, carrot sticks, cauliflower and broccoli florets, red bell pepper, a few Jerusalem artichokes, with a bowl of pale creamy walnut hummus drizzled with olive oil, some crumbled feta and olives.

37.title: Kålcurry med gröna ärter och koriander
37.prompt: A bowl of Indian-style white cabbage curry: finely chopped cabbage stir-fried until soft with golden edges in warm yellow-orange spices with mustard seeds and cumin, bright green peas folded in, plenty of coarsely chopped fresh coriander on top, a side of steamed basmati rice.

38.title: Sommargryta med vitkål, zucchini och dill
38.prompt: A shallow pot of summer vegetable stew: slices of potato, golden pan-fried zucchini slices, soft white cabbage and onion in a light tomato and crème fraîche broth, topped with a generous scattering of chopped fresh dill, garlic and lemon zest, a piece of rustic baguette beside it.

39.title: Kålpannkaka med zucchini och sojadipp
39.prompt: A plate stacked with small Korean-style savoury vegetable pancakes, thin and lightly golden, with visible shreds of pointed cabbage, zucchini sticks and spring onion and flecks of red chili flakes, a small bowl of dark soy-vinegar dipping sauce and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds.

42.title: Pork ramen – nudelsoppa med chilistekt fläskfärs
42.prompt: A large bowl of ramen: clear golden chicken broth with wavy noodles, a generous pile of crumbly browned minced pork fried with chili flakes and garlic (loose crumbles, not patties or slices), quartered mushrooms, pieces of pak choi, a halved soft-boiled egg with a jammy orange yolk, fresh coriander leaves on top, chopsticks resting on the rim.

44.title: Morotssoppa med apelsin och basilika
44.prompt: A bowl of smooth bright orange carrot soup with a hint of orange juice, blended until silky, topped with a swirl, fresh basil leaves and a sprinkle of pumpkin and sunflower seeds.

46.title: Röd linsgryta med potatis
46.prompt: A bowl of thick red-orange lentil and tomato stew with soft cubes of potato, warmly spiced with cumin and coriander, rustic and homely, a spoon beside the bowl.

49.title: Senapsdressad pärlcouscous
49.prompt: A bowl of pearl couscous (large round Israeli couscous) tossed in a glossy mustard and honey vinaigrette with lots of chopped fresh dill, pale golden and simple, served as a side salad.

50.title: Fisk med örtsås
50.prompt: A plate of poached white fish fillet covered in a light pale herb sauce made from fish stock and white wine with chopped thyme, basil and parsley, halved blistered cherry tomatoes on top and around, with boiled potatoes on the side.

51.title: Pasta med lax och sås på vitt vin, grädde och spenat
51.prompt: A plate of pasta (tagliatelle) in a creamy white wine sauce with cubes of pan-fried salmon, wilted chopped spinach and shallots, flecked with thyme and parsley, a lemon wedge beside it.

52.title: Amandas pasta med morötter, lök & sweet chili
52.prompt: A bowl of pasta tossed with a creamy pale orange sauce of grated carrot, soft strips of fried yellow onion, crème fraîche and sweet chili sauce, with green peas folded in and a sprinkle of chopped nuts on top, simple vegetarian weeknight dinner.

53.title: Indisk gryta med spenat, kikärter, senap & yoghurt
53.prompt: A bowl of Indian chickpea and spinach stew: chickpeas in a thick dark green and red-brown tomato-yoghurt sauce with lots of chopped spinach, warm spices, served with a mound of white rice beside it.

54.title: Majsplättar med kokosmjölk
54.prompt: A plate with a stack of small thin Swedish pancakes (plättar) with an even, smooth golden-brown surface like plain pancakes, served with a bowl of tzatziki, a small dish of sweet chili sauce and some carrot sticks, child-friendly dinner.

55.title: Amandas laxbiffar
55.prompt: A plate with four pan-fried salmon patties: round, rustic, pale pink-orange minced salmon patties with a golden crust and flecks of herbs and onion, served with boiled potatoes and a wedge of lemon, no whole fillets, no eggs visible.

58.title: Broccolipesto
58.prompt: A small bowl of thick green broccoli pesto with visible texture of blended broccoli, toasted nuts and seeds and grated parmesan, drizzled with rapeseed oil, a spoon in it, some toasted bread or pasta beside it.

59.title: Krämig bönmasala
59.prompt: A bowl of creamy red-orange bean masala: mixed cooked beans in a smooth tomato, carrot and yoghurt sauce with garam masala, with soft melting pieces of mozzarella and chopped cashew nuts stirred in, served with rice.

60.title: Oreganokyckling
60.prompt: A pan of chicken breast strips browned and simmered in a creamy pale sauce with dried oregano, garlic and a touch of balsamic vinegar, served with rice or potatoes and a green salad on the side.

62.title: Rödbetsrisotto
62.prompt: A plate of deep magenta beetroot risotto, creamy with grated parmesan, topped with a spoonful of white yoghurt mixed with chèvre, a scattering of toasted nuts and seeds and a little black pepper.

64.title: Färgstark grönsakswok
64.prompt: A wok or plate of colourful stir-fried vegetables, still crisp: strips of red onion, diagonal slices of leek, chunky strips of red and yellow bell pepper, long carrot ribbons and sliced celery, lightly seasoned with garam masala, served with saffron-yellow couscous and a spoonful of thick natural yoghurt.

183.title: Butternutpumpa- och poblano-sallad med fetaost
183.prompt: A platter of roasted salad: cubes of roasted orange butternut squash and strips of roasted dark green poblano pepper, sweetcorn kernels, crumbled white feta, toasted pumpkin seeds and torn mint leaves, drizzled with a red harissa-lime dressing.

263.title: Örtig tortellinisoppa
263.prompt: A bowl of smooth red tomato soup with a swirl of cream, with cheese tortellini floating in it: small ring-shaped folded stuffed pasta parcels with pinched edges (tortellini), fresh oregano and basil leaves, grated parmesan on top.

264.title: Väffeltoast med rökt kalkon, äpple och dijonkräm
264.prompt: Toasted sandwiches pressed in a waffle iron so the wholegrain bread has a golden waffle pattern, cut open to show melted cheese, thin slices of smoked turkey and thin slices of green apple with dijon crème fraîche, served with snack vegetables (cucumber, carrot sticks) and a glass of milk.

265.title: Snabbrimmad torsk med ägg och persilja
265.prompt: A plate of oven-baked white cod fillet with a creamy white sauce poured over, topped with a generous sprinkle of finely chopped egg crumble (tiny crumbs of boiled egg white and yolk mixed with chopped curly parsley, like a gremolata scattered over the fish), with boiled potatoes, green peas and a few tomato wedges on the side, classic Swedish fish dinner.

267.title: Örtiga minibiffar med potatismos
267.prompt: A plate of small herby minced beef patties (mini pan-fried meatballs flattened into little patties) with golden crust and flecks of oregano, some stuffed with feta and olives, served with a generous mound of creamy mashed potatoes, a light cream gravy and a spoonful of lingonberries.

268.title: Nudelwok med thai-basilika och ostronsås
268.prompt: A wok of stir-fried egg noodles with shredded kale and cabbage, carrot strips, bell pepper, mushrooms and cubes of golden fried tofu in a glossy dark oyster sauce, topped with chopped peanuts, sliced spring onion, Thai basil leaves and a lime wedge.

269.title: Gräddig Cashew-Kyckling med Curry
269.prompt: A bowl of chicken pieces in a creamy golden yellow curry sauce made from blended parsnip, turmeric, cream and cashew nuts, with green haricots verts, served over rice, topped with toasted coconut flakes, fresh coriander and a few cherry tomatoes.

270.title: Brysselkålbonara
270.prompt: A plate of spaghetti coated in a glossy pale creamy parmesan sauce clinging to the strands, tossed with quartered pan-fried Brussels sprouts with crispy caramelised edges and chopped toasted hazelnuts, cracked black pepper and a little lemon zest, nothing on top of the pasta except sprouts, nuts and grated parmesan.

271.title: Tikka Masala
271.prompt: A bowl of tikka masala: strips of chicken in a smooth, creamy red-orange tomato and coconut sauce, served with basmati rice, topped with fresh coriander, cubes of mango and chopped peanuts.

272.title: Jordnöts- och kikärtsgryta med kokosris
272.prompt: A bowl of peanut chickpea curry: chickpeas in a rich golden-brown coconut and peanut butter sauce with red curry paste and wilted spinach, served over white coconut rice, topped with chopped salted peanuts, fresh coriander and a spoonful of red chili crisp.

274.title: Fiskgryta med lax och tomat
274.prompt: A bowl of quick salmon stew: chunks of pink salmon and whole snap peas in a creamy pale red tomato and cream sauce with lots of chopped fresh dill, served with white rice.

275.title: Blomkålsgryta med indiska smaker
275.prompt: A pot of Indian-spiced cauliflower stew: oven-roasted cauliflower florets with golden tips in a creamy orange tomato and coconut sauce with strips of red bell pepper, garnished with coriander, served with basmati rice and a piece of naan bread.

276.title: Nabas marockanska harirarasoppa
276.prompt: A bowl of Moroccan harira soup: a thick red-brown tomato soup with chickpeas, small risoni pasta, finely chopped celery and warm spices (cinnamon, turmeric, paprika), topped with fresh coriander, served with lemon wedges and a piece of baguette.

277.title: Lövbiffsrullader med färskost
277.prompt: A pan of browned beef roulades (thin minute steaks rolled around garlic-and-herb cream cheese, held with toothpicks) in a creamy pepper sauce with crushed black, green and pink peppercorns, served with oven-roasted vegetables or potatoes, pressed cucumber and a spoon of blackcurrant jelly.

278.title: Oxjärpar i krämig gräddsås
278.prompt: A pan of oval Swedish beef patties (järpar, like elongated meatballs) simmering in a creamy light brown gravy flavoured with dijon mustard and thyme, served with boiled potatoes or roasted root vegetables, lingonberries and chopped parsley.

279.title: Biffnudelsallad med chili- & limedressing
279.prompt: A large bowl of Thai-style beef noodle salad: cold rice noodles with ribbons of carrot, sliced spring onion and bean sprouts, topped with thinly sliced medium-rare seared beef, charred pak choi wedges, toasted sesame seeds and coriander, with a glossy chili-lime fish sauce dressing drizzled over.

280.title: Kålmaja på nolltid
280.prompt: A pan of Swedish kålmaja: browned minced beef and strips of soft pointed cabbage and onion in a creamy light brown sauce with a touch of syrup and soy, served with boiled potatoes, raw stirred lingonberries, chopped parsley and pressed cucumber.

281.title: Turkisk manti på 10 minuter
281.prompt: A plate of Turkish-style manti shortcut: pasta topped with a generous dollop of thick garlic yoghurt, spiced browned minced beef with onion, finely chopped tomato and parsley, drizzled with melted butter stained red with paprika or Aleppo pepper.

282.title: Persisk makaroni med krispig tadig
282.prompt: Persian makaroni tahdig: a round golden dome of spaghetti turned out of the pot onto a plate, the outside is a crispy golden-brown crust of fried spaghetti strands, one wedge cut away showing spaghetti tangled together with a red saffron-tinted minced beef and tomato sauce inside, sprinkled with chopped parsley. It is a pasta dish, pressed and flipped out of a pot, not a dessert.

283.title: Kebabgryta med sting
283.prompt: A pot of Swedish kebab stew: strips of kebab meat in a spicy red tomato sauce with paprika, cumin and curry, served with warm pita bread, rice and a bowl of white garlic sauce.

284.title: Tacogratäng med potatis
284.prompt: A rectangular oven dish of taco gratin: thin slices of potato layered with taco-spiced minced beef and salsa, topped with a creamy crème fraîche and sweet chili layer and melted golden grated cheese, served with nacho chips and a bowl of iceberg lettuce, tomato and cucumber.

285.title: Kycklinggratäng med röd pesto
285.prompt: An oven dish of chicken gratin: browned chicken fillet halves and whole cherry tomatoes with strips of sun-dried tomato in a creamy red pesto sauce, topped with melted golden mozzarella and fresh basil leaves, a bowl of couscous on the side.

286.title: Kycklinggratäng med basilika & bacon
286.prompt: An oven dish of chicken gratin: slices of browned chicken in a creamy mushroom sauce with crispy bacon pieces, parmesan and basil, baked golden on top, served with cooked whole wheat grain (matvete) and rocket leaves.

287.title: Basmatiris med biryanitäcke
287.prompt: A platter of fluffy white basmati rice covered with a biryani-style topping of golden fried chicken pieces and onion with turmeric and cardamom, chickpeas, toasted cashew nuts, plump raisins and toasted vermicelli strands, served with a bowl of mint yoghurt.

288.title: Kycklinggryta med smak av saffran
288.prompt: A pot of golden-orange saffron chicken stew: pieces of chicken thigh, chunks of carrot and red bell pepper in a fragrant turmeric, cinnamon and tomato broth tinted yellow by saffron, served with basmati rice.
